stories.title: Senedd committees finalised as eight-week summer recess begins
stories.summary: Senedd Members have taken up their positions in Cardiff Bay, with parliamentary committees now in full swing as the Welsh Parliament enters its eight-week summer recess. stories.title: North Wales law firm rallies behind brave Flintshire toddler in £1.5m race for life
stories.summary: A North Wales law firm has launched a major fundraiser to help a 13-month-old boy battling a devastating one-in-a-million condition. Swayne Johnson has organised a charity event in aid of the £1.5 million Rupert’s Rainbow appeal for little Rupert Smith whose rare illness can trigger seizures, paralysis-like episodes and life-threatening breathing difficulties. stories.title: Voluntary Aided Flintshire schools ‘hanging by a thread’
stories.summary: Voluntary Aided schools in Flintshire are ‘hanging on by a thread’ and risk becoming unviable due to ageing buildings and declining pupil numbers. stories.title: Reallocation of dog bin after seven month wait ‘unacceptable’ says Flintshire councillor
stories.summary: A new dog bin to combat an epidemic of dog fouling in Buckley took seven months to arrive then was redirected to replace a damaged bin before it could be installed. stories.title: More than 400 attend opening day of free Flintshire summer programme
stories.summary: More than 400 children and family members attended the opening day of Fit, Fed and Read, as the free summer programme returned to Flintshire. Launch sessions took place in Flint and Sealand, offering families an afternoon of free activities, food and reading.
